title: Nested first projection of a paired input
statement: For bit strings $x,U,t,u,j,p$, let $\langle a,b\rangle$ denote the encoding obtained by doubling each bit of $a$, appending the separator $01$, and then appending $b$. Applying the total first projection twice to $\langle\langle x,U\rangle,t\rangle$ returns $x$.
